Isolated regression fixture, macOS 27.0 / Apple Silicon, FluidVoice 1.6.12-beta.1 source.

15 XCTest methods passed, 0 failures.
Tests compile the real recovery views into a standalone XCTest bundle with
an in-memory clipboard. No app lifecycle or system clipboard is used.

Checks include changed and identical consecutive transcripts, rendered button
feedback reset, repeated copies, clipboard failures and retries, compact cards,
and stale dismissal cancellation on replacement/disappearance.

Mutation checks: removing only transient presentation identity produced two
expected feedback failures; removing only inline feedback reset produced two.
Both screenshots show the second transcript in the isolated regression fixture:
recovery-copy-before.png has identity reset disabled, after.png has the fix.

Full app-hosted suite, Intel, and live Grok dictation after this fix were not run.
